name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: Travis County Health and Human Services with Austin Public Health
what_you_do: You get paid summer work experience at a host site. There are more than 80 host sites. They are businesses, nonprofits and government offices. You first complete a required job readiness training.
who_can_apply: Must be 14 to 18 (14 by April 1) and in middle or high school, and must live and/or attend school in Travis County. Teens with disabilities can apply up to age 22. Other factors such as household income may also be considered.
pay_detail: Paid work experience; hourly rate not stated on the program page
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The county says applications for Summer 2027 open in January 2027 (exact date not posted). Fill out the 2027 interest form to be told when they open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application (Jotform) and upload a Social Security card and a school ID or recent report card. Eligible applicants are invited to a mandatory job readiness training, then matched to a host site if space allows. Applying does not guarantee a placement.
notes: Phone 512-854-4590, syep@traviscountytx.gov. Up to 750 paid spots each year. Pay rate and hours are not stated on the page. The page does not mention a work permit. Texas rules for 14 and 15 year olds limit hours (see Texas Workforce Commission child labor page). The SAFE Alliance Summer Youth Leadership Academy also hires through this program.
